lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Huff... huff... Ha! That was one hell of a strike.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: You almost had me there, Shanks. The fog in this swamp is finally clearing.

lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Heh, you've earned your pass. Your blade didn't hesitate for even a second.

lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: Beyond this marsh lies uncharted, ruthless territory. Only true kings survive what's waiting.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: No matter what comes, I won't turn back now.

lines.speaker: Shanks
lines.text: That's what I wanted to hear! Go out there, carve your legend, and don't look back!
